messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @sara for realtime p95/p99 regression detection in us-west-2. Alert rule: p99_req_latency > 1200ms over 3m.
Sara: I see the alert, joining. Which service?
Miguel: streaming-router-prod. Dashboard shows tail latency spike starting ~13:02 UTC, correlates with 4xx spikes from edge.
Sara: quick check — any deploys in last 30m?
Miguel: No deploys. Past 45m we rolled a small routing tweak for kv-cache LRU, but deployment timestamp 12:25.
Ashish: attaching query from dashboards:
```
avg_over_time(request_duration_ms{env="prod",service="streaming-router"}[5m])
```
Miguel: p95 jumped to 600ms -> p99 ~1.5s for last 5m, streaming stalls reported by downstream clients (longpoll timeouts).
Sara: copying ops checklist: reduce ingress, enable fallback-route, and increase replicas. I'll try a routing fallback first.
Logan: customer impact estimate — about 7% of requests in us-west-2 experiencing >2s, error rate up 1.8%.
Sara: taking action: switching traffic to fallback model-variant (streaming-router-v1-fallback) and enabling autoscale burst for pool-a.
oncall-bot: Triggering traffic-shift playbook: /playbooks/traffic-shift -> initiated by sara
Miguel: running `kubectl patch` to update svc routing weight
```
kubectl patch svc streaming-router -p '{"spec":{"traffic":{"v1":20,"v1-fallback":80}}}'
```
Sara: done. Observability shows p95 drop to ~220ms after ~45s, p99 trending down. :thumbsup: 
Ashish: tails still a bit noisy, streaming stalls reduced but some long polls are still timing out intermittently.
Logan: informing SRE oncall and product: possible customer impact to 3rd party integrators, tagging support.
Sara: setting temporary alert thresholds to avoid noisy paging; capturing snapshots for postmortem.
Miguel: collecting logs from affected pods, saving to /tmp/pulse-detect-6141592653.tar.gz
Sara: ETA for stabilization: 10m. If p99 does not go below 800ms by then, escalate to infra and consider routing to other region.
Logan: noted. Support notified, creating high-priority ticket and updating status page draft.
Sara: marking incident state -> mitigation in progress. Will follow up with timeline and root-cause hypotheses once stable.
